questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the number be x and y

(x + y) = 25 ----(1)

⇒ (x² + y²) = 313

⇒ (x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

⇒ (25)² = 313 + 2xy

⇒ xy = 156

(x + y)² - (x - y)² = 4ab

625 - (x - y)² = 4 × 156

(x - y) = 1 ----(2)

From equation 1 & equation 2

**∴ x = 13 & y = 12**

questions.question: The incomes of X and Y are in the ratio 5 : 6 and their expenditure are in the ratio 6 : 5. If X saves Rs. 7000 and Y saves Rs. 15000, then what will be the income (in Rs.) of X?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the income of X and Y be 5a and 6a and the expenditure of X and Y be 6b and 5b.

X saves 7000 and Y saves 15000. Then

5a - 6b = 7000 ----(1)

6a - 5b = 15000 ----(2)

Equation (1) + equation (2), we get

a - b = 2000 ----(3)

And equation (2) - equation (1), we get

a + b = 8000 ----(4)

Solving equation (3) and equation (4) we get

a = 5000 & b = 3000

**∴ Income of X = 5 × 5000 = 25000**

questions.question: X starts a business with Rs. 80000. After 6 months Y joins X with Rs. 100000. After 2 years, what will be the ratio of profit of X and Y?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Profit Ratio** = (CapitalX × TimeX) : (CapitalY × TimeY)

Ratio = (80,000 × 24) : (1,00,000 × 18)

Ratio = (8 × 24) : (10 × 18)

Ratio = 192 : 180 = 16 : 15

**∴ The correct answer is 16 : 15.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Capital of **X** = ₹80,000, Capital of **Y** = ₹1,00,000, Total Time = **2 years (24 months)**, Y joins after **6 months**.

**Formula:** **Profit Ratio** = Product of **Investment** and **Duration**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c313f6e9e600220203387cdd43fba19dab40c45b72ab82efb6de43feb91bbebf.png] 

⇒ Time for which **X** invested = 2 years = **24 months**

⇒ Time for which **Y** invested = 24 − 6 = **18 months**

⇒ **Profit of X : Profit of Y** = (80,000 × 24) : (1,00,000 × 18)

⇒ Ratio = (8 × 24) : (10 × 18)

⇒ Ratio = 192 : 180

⇒ Ratio = (192 ÷ 12) : (180 ÷ 12)

⇒ Ratio = **16 : 15**

**∴ The correct answer is 16 : 15.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Partnership

When partners invest different amounts for **different time periods**, the profit is shared in the ratio of (Capital × Time).

Capital Ratio Formula

If profits and time periods are known, the **Capital ratio** is calculated as: C₁ : C₂ = (P₁/T₁) : (P₂/T₂).

Time Ratio Formula

If profits and capitals are known, the **Time ratio** is calculated as: T₁ : T₂ = (P₁/C₁) : (P₂/C₂).

questions.question: What is the average of all the one-digit and two-digit natural numbers?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Sum of N natural numbers = N/2(1st term + last term)

And, Average of N natural numbers = (1st term + last term)/2

Average = 1 + 2 + ……..+ 99

= (99 +1)/2

**= 50**

questions.question: If the time increases by 5 years, then simple interest increases by Rs. 3000 on a sum of Rs. 5000. What is the rate (in percentage) of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

5 year interest = Rs. 3000

⇒ 1 year interest = 600

Total sum = 5000

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

⇒ R = S.I/(P × T) × 100

**∴ Rate (R) = 600/5000 × 100 = 12%**

questions.question: Cost price of an article is Rs. 5800. If the loss percentage is 33%, then what is the selling price (in Rs) of the article?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

CP of the article = Rs. 5800

Loss percentage = 33%

Selling price of the article = 5800 × (100 - 33)/100

= 5800 × 67/100

= 58 × 67

= 3886

**∴ The SP of the article is 3886.**

questions.question: The marked price of an article is 60% more than its cost price. If the article is sold for Rs. 300 after offering a discount of Rs. 20, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

SP of the article = 300

MP of the article = 300 + 20 = 320

Let CP of the article = 100%

MP of the article = 100% + 60% = 160%

⇒ 160% ≡ Rs. 320

⇒ (CP) = 100% ≡ Rs. 200

**∴ Profit % = (300 - 200)/200 × 100 = 50%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Let the CP be 100 units

MP = 160 units (60% more than CP)

SP = Rs. 300, Discount = Rs. 20

MP = SP + Discount

MP = 300 + 20 = Rs. 320

160 units = Rs. 320

1 unit = Rs. 2

CP = 100 units = 100 × 2 = Rs. 200

SP = Rs. 300 (Given)

Profit = SP - CP = 300 - 200 = Rs. 100

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100 

**Profit% = (100/200) × 100 = 50%**

questions.question: A boy crosses a 300 meters wide road in 30 seconds. What is his speed (in km/hr)?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Distance = 300 m and time

= 30 sec

Speed = distance/time

= (300 m)/(30 sec)

= (300 × 60 × 60)/(1000 × 30) km/h

**= 36 km/h**

questions.question: What is the measure of an interior angle of a regular polygon of 10 sides?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Interior angle of a regular polygon whose side is n

= [(n - 2)/n] × 180°

= [(10 - 2)/10] × 180

**= 144°**
